responsibility: Declares diagnostics::context and the related policy classes that snapshot formatting state for locations and quoted source. It defines the main subsystem object that owns counters, sinks, option classifiers, buffering state, fix-it change sets, client hooks, diagram support, original argv, and grouping/nesting bookkeeping, along with column_policy, location_print_policy, and source_print_policy helpers that package context options and file-cache access for location text generation and source-locus rendering.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the context pair: it defines the diagnostics::context data structure, its owned state, and the column/location/source policy helper classes that other diagnostics code includes. Unlike context.cc, it does not implement initialization, reporting behavior, sink coordination, or selftest bodies.
